run_wait_for_cuberite_cli: run the wait_for_cuberite CLI tool to wait for a Cuberite Minecraft server to come up on localhost:25565
run_wait_for_server_socket: run wait_for_server to retry connecting to a host and port via socket until the server is available
create_wait_for_cuberite_function: create a function that waits for a Cuberite server by checking socket connectivity and pinging the server
test_wait_for_server_retries: test wait_for_server to verify it retries socket connections up to max_tries times before raising ConnectionError
review_wait_for_cuberite_timeout: review wait_for_cuberite to understand how it combines socket polling with a ping check for server readiness
